admission.justification: Spans language_catalog.lock.json, language_catalog.py, and grammars.py, is guarded by AST and dependency-purity tests, and anchors the uniform catalog half of the FAM-CSVQBJ extraction seam.

applicability: Shipped tree-sitter and built-in citation language metadata in package_data/citations/language_catalog.lock.json, language_catalog.py, and grammars.py.
conditions: Every shipped language is declared once in language_catalog.lock.json with canonical id, unambiguous suffixes/filenames/shebangs, pinned wheel or language-pack SHA-256 digests, verified tags.scm/tests.scm SHA-256 digests, and wrapper/destructuring specs.
language_catalog.py verifies packaged .scm query SHA-256 hashes and rejects duplicate ids, ambiguous default suffix claims, or reserved .lean claims before returning a LanguageCatalog.
grammars.py builds DEFAULT_LANGUAGE_SET from the catalog lock with zero hardcoded language tables or suffix-to-grammar maps.
exclusions: Per-repository languages.json overrides and user settings overrides are layered on top by language_config.py and language_scanner.py rather than stored in the shipped lockfile.
statement: Every supported catalog language is declared solely in the bundled hash-pinned language_catalog.lock.json data lock with canonical id, unambiguous suffixes/filenames/shebangs, pinned pypi_wheel or language_pack artifact hashes, verified tags.scm/tests.scm SHA-256 digests, and wrapper/destructuring rules, while core citation modules hardcode no language lists.
title: Bundled hash-pinned language catalog is sole shipped language table
